name: AEG-77 Vigo
description: The AEG-77 Vigo was a transport vessel of the criminal Black Sun organization that was also used by Xizor Transport Systems and other organizations and individuals at the time of the Galactic Civil War. Some ships were heavily modified for use as convoy escorts.

data.name: AEG-77 Vigo
data.capacity: 25 tons (100 tons in unarmed transport version)
